purpose: Measure actual Hyperliquid Portfolio Margin account behavior and incremental maintenance consumption for a small matched UBTC spot + BTC short-perp pair after CARRY-IMPL-0034 passed public feasibility.

prerequisites.btc_spot_representation: official UI BTC -> HyperCore UBTC remap

fixed_four_stage_sequence.label: cash
fixed_four_stage_sequence.state: Portfolio Margin enabled; dedicated account/subaccount; no BTC perp; no UBTC spot position used for the probe

fixed_four_stage_sequence.label: spot
fixed_four_stage_sequence.state: Acquire UBTC spot only; actual observed UBTC spot notional must be >0 and <= $500 plus 5% execution tolerance; no BTC short yet

fixed_four_stage_sequence.label: matched
fixed_four_stage_sequence.state: Hold the same UBTC spot and a BTC short-perp matched to the spot economic notional within 2%; no other perp position

fixed_four_stage_sequence.label: closed
fixed_four_stage_sequence.state: Close BTC short and exit the probe UBTC spot; verify the account returns flat in the two probe legs

primary_observables: BTC perp position size and notional
live UBTC spot and BTC perp midpoint
capital_efficiency_gate_rationale: The 25% threshold is a coarse preregistered structural discriminator, not a parameter search. It requires the short leg's observed incremental maintenance consumption to be materially below a near-fully-funded second leg before any PM-aware stack accounting is reopened.
pass_authority: PASS_PM_ACCOUNT_BEHAVIOR authorizes only one separately preregistered PM-aware BRRK + frozen CARRY-0031 stack accounting experiment using the observed capital factor. It does not authorize production, leverage search, weight optimization, funding thresholds, asset removal, or parameter tuning.
failure_rule: If the first valid four-stage probe fails or is inconclusive, preserve the result. Diagnose only API/state/implementation defects. Do not tune the 2% match tolerance, 0.50 PM ratio gate, 25% incremental-maintenance gate, $500 notional cap, or account structure on the observed outcome.
